name: byrdAI
description: byrd is a European e-commerce fulfillment provider (3PL) that stores, picks, packs, and ships orders for online brands. This connector brings your byrd fulfillment and inventory data into Claude, so you can ask questions in plain language and get instant answers and reports - no dashboards, exports, or spreadsheets needed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add byrdAI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add byrdAI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://eule.getbyrd.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the byrdAI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: byrdAI lists 21 MCP tools, including count_inventory, count_shipments, get_bundle_contents, get_inventory_for_sku, get_merchant_info, get_shipment_details, get_sla_guidance, list_low_stock_items, query_inventory, query_shipments, report_abc_analysis, and report_days_of_cover.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to byrdAI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to byrdAI in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.
byrdAI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
byrdAI is developed by byrd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
